title: Habit Tracker
tagline: Track daily habits with focused mobile workflows
description: A Flutter-based habit tracking app with Firebase authentication, Firestore-backed habit data, and multiple progress views.

overview.problem: Users need a simple way to create habits, track completion, and review progress over time.
overview.audience: People building personal routines on mobile.
objectives: Provide straightforward habit creation and management
Visualize progress across days and categories
goals: Reliable cloud-backed storage for user habits
constraints: No verified analytics data in repository
No backend service layer beyond Firebase SDK usage
overview.valueProposition: A focused habit management experience with cloud synchronization and lightweight UI flows.

features.name: Authentication flow
features.description: Email/password and Google sign-in with onboarding and welcome transitions.
features.userValue: Users can create and access accounts quickly.
features.implementation: FirebaseAuth integrated via AuthenticationRepository and UserRepo.

features.name: Habit management
features.description: Create, update, delete, and list habits tied to authenticated users.
features.userValue: Users can maintain evolving habit plans.

features.name: Progress visualization
features.description: Checklist, calendar, and heat-map style progress screens.
features.userValue: Users can evaluate consistency over time.
features.implementation: Dedicated core screens with calendar/heatmap dependencies.

design.visualDirection: Color-rich mobile-first interface with icon-driven navigation.
design.interactionStyle: Bottom-nav workflow with modal and route-based transitions.
designDecisions: Focused four-tab navigation in app entry point

challenges.title: Authentication-driven startup routing
challenges.problem: The app needs to route users to onboarding/welcome or app entry based on auth state.
challenges.difficulty: Managing auth stream updates with screen transitions.
challenges.investigation: Reviewing GetX lifecycle hooks and Firebase auth user stream behavior.
challenges.solution: Reactive listener in AuthenticationRepository.onReady with GetX navigation.
tradeoffs: Tight coupling between repository and navigation
challenges.outcome: Consistent startup routing based on signed-in state.

verifiedOutcomes: Functional habit CRUD screens and account flow are present in source
learnings: Separation between data validation and visual presentation improves reusability.
limitations: No verified production metrics found in repository
futureImprovements: Add local screenshots specifically for portfolio case-study media
